candidates.text: Lefkowitz claims Kaplan’s at 6:30 PM, which is when the last edition coming off the truck was on. Asked about it, Lefkowitz cannot say that the late edition led with the bridge contract and not the hold-up — and everybody who was there can.
Sweeney still carries it: ink still wet enough to come off on a glove. The last edition coming off the truck was at 6:30 PM, at Kaplan’s.

The man who sells it at Kaplan’s gives it up rather than be held: Alfano was there from 7:00 PM to 7:30 PM, and stayed until it took hold.
The doctor Alfano used to see confirms the habit and the hour: Alfano was at Kaplan’s from 7:00 PM to 7:30 PM, and could not have crossed the street unhelped.
